name: Exploring product-truth flows in the Atlas
summary: The user journey through the Atlas /flows view: open the view to see every flow listed, filter by source (mock vs real) and kind (user/data/architecture), select a flow to render its graph, open a step to inspect its acceptance criteria's live status plus the mock records and mockup it uses, and cross-jump from an acceptance criterion back to the flows it appears in. This is how a person sees product truth visually rather than reading JSON.

steps.human:
The person changes source and realization filters over the already-loaded Flow records. React updates local state and the visible subset; no network request or persisted filter DTO is produced. [Filter implementation](leafcutter-web/components/flows/flows-view.tsx).

steps.label: Jump from an AC to the flows it appears in
steps.human:
The AC detail UI looks up its appearances in the internal map built by flowAppearancesByAc, then offers links naming flow and step/branch. The historical stepId property can identify either node kind. Following a link is UI navigation, not a JSON mutation. [Map producer](leafcutter-web/lib/data/flows.ts).
